verdicts.reason: A: the white panel bleeds off the top and right edges and covers most of the pop-art shapes. The FIZZBANG badge has been pulled out of the panel and sits on the pink circle, navy quarter-circle and yellow stripe, and the CTA is pushed hard against the panel's right edge. Still, the headline reads cleanly on one line. B has the same off-canvas panel and the same badge collision with the stripe and circle, and it is worse: the headline breaks into two lines with 'can' orphaned on the second line, unevenly centred, which leaves awkward empty space and looks unintentional.
